phase: P1 twelfth increment: explicit typed sizing, single-signal producer bridge, bounded archive reads and audited never-submitted cleanup
implemented: Exact typed sizing with explicit scoped account/quote/filter/leverage facts, maximum 70% margin pool after venue usage and pending reservations, portfolio residual stop risk, costs/drift, floor quantity and outward stop tick. No fabricated legacy score or automatic leverage selection.

Single-signal producer reads original durable receipt/candidate before fact I/O, then exact environment catalog, closed server bars, scoped sizing and plan-bound safety context. First writer freezes immutable original identity.

Freeze locks route then signal then account, checks current deployment and PG time in the commit transaction. Absolute expiry includes catalog/structure/availability/decision/account/filter/venue/book/quote limits, including safety read and lock waits.

Read-only single-symbol SANDBOX archive reader bounds raw rows including duplicates, bytes and time; checks complete windows, scope, payload digest, conflicting duplicates and candle shape. Dedicated exact read-only client profile, no implicit LIMIT, no retries, verified short receive timeout, driver-setting preflight.

Current MANAGE owner may terminate only order-free RECEIVED or a sole original MARKET PREPARED request with no fills/exchange identity/submission event, after original plan/opportunity/deployment proof. DRAINING/OFF/replaced/expired causes are journaled; UNKNOWN/SUBMITTING/ACK preserve risk and reconciliation.
Execution route guard returns phase only after full current account/binding/token validation and role restoration, while locks remain held until business commit.

qa.boundary: Single temporary PG16/Redis harness, Unix sockets, external TCP forbidden by test boundary. ClickHouse client tests are offline/fake responses, including installed real driver validation; no venue or running database calls.
